cat > /tmp/monitor_responses.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
MAX_POLLS=40
INTERVAL=90
RESPONSES_DIR="/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001/data/arena_hard/responses"

for i in $(seq 1 $MAX_POLLS); do
    llama=$(wc -l < "$RESPONSES_DIR/llama-3.3-70b.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    qwen=$(wc -l < "$RESPONSES_DIR/qwen2.5-72b.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    mistral=$(wc -l < "$RESPONSES_DIR/mistral-large-2.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    
    echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] Poll $i/$MAX_POLLS: llama=$llama qwen=$qwen mistral=$mistral"
    
    if [ "$llama" -ge 500 ] && [ "$qwen" -ge 500 ] && [ "$mistral" -ge 500 ]; then
        echo "ALL_COMPLETE"
        exit 0
    fi
    
    sleep $INTERVAL
done

echo "TIMEOUT_NOT_COMPLETE"
exit 1
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/monitor_responses.sh
nohup bash /tmp/monitor_responses.sh > /tmp/monitor_responses.log 2>&1 &
echo "Monitor PID: $!"
